paper_title: Axion Dark Matter from Cosmic String Network
notes: Lattice simulation of axion production from cosmic strings in the post-inflationary scenario, deriving a lower bound on the QCD axion mass (equivalently an upper bound on f_a) by requiring the string-radiated axion abundance not exceed the observed DM density. This is a cosmological bound on the f_a-m_a plane (AxionMass type), not a laboratory measurement. However, the provided paper content is truncated before the explicit numerical value of the mass lower bound is stated (Section 8.1 references Omega_mis h^2 ~ 0.12 (28 ueV/ma)^(7/6) as an input, and quotes xi_star = 13.4/16.6 and spectral-index fits, but the final bound value is not present). No extractable data points; extraction_confidence set below 0.3 accordingly.
